title: Artificial Shoppers and Attention Competition
abstract: arXiv:2611.09399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how AI shopping interfaces affect price competition, platform profit, and consumer welfare. A platform hosts two of three products of different quality. Without AI, consumers compare the hosted pair under salience distortion and overweight whichever attribute, price or quality, stands out. Under assistance, an AI assistant recommends the two products with the highest true utility, leaving consumers to make the same distorted comparison. Under delegation, an AI agent selects the best product, subject to purchase approval. Both modes access all products and know consumers' preferences; firms price strategically. First, assistance can soften competition despite expanded product access. The middle-quality firm may forgo low-valuation consumers because attracting them requires cutting the price paid by higher-valuation consumers as well. translated_title: 人工购物者与注意力竞争
translated_abstract: 我们研究AI购物界面如何影响价格竞争、平台利润和消费者福利。一个平台托管三种不同质量产品中的两种。在没有AI的情况下，消费者在显著性扭曲的影响下比较托管的两款产品，并过度重视价格或质量中更为突出的属性。在辅助模式下，AI助手推荐真实效用最高的两款产品，消费者随后进行同样存在扭曲的比较。在委托模式下，AI代理选择最佳产品，但购买需经用户批准。两种模式都能访问所有产品并了解消费者的偏好；企业则进行策略性定价。首先，尽管产品获取范围扩大，辅助模式仍可能弱化竞争。中等质量的企业可能会放弃低估值消费者，因为吸引这类消费者需要同时降低高估值消费者所支付的价格。相对于相同产品组合下没有AI的情况，辅助模式在高（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 本文研究AI购物界面（辅助模式与委托模式）对价格竞争、平台利润和消费者福利的影响，发现尽管AI辅助扩大了消费者的产品选择范围，反而可能弱化价格竞争，因为中等质量企业会为保住高估值消费者而放弃低估值消费者。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how AI shopping interfaces (assistance vs. delegation modes) affect price competition, platform profit, and consumer welfare, finding that AI assistance can soften competition despite expanded product access, as the middle-quality firm may forgo low-valuation consumers to protect prices paid by higher-valuation ones.
